description: Statutory revenue certificate certifying total annual household income across all legal sources for admissions, government scholarships, state subsidies, and fee remissions.
eligibility: Permanent resident of Uttarakhand or residing lawfully in the state with verifiable economic activity.
Head of family or applicant declaring lawful family income with supporting revenue evidence.
No duplicate active income certificate issued within the same financial year.

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / Photo ID
requiredDocuments.details: Self-attested identity proof with local Uttarakhand address.

requiredDocuments.name: Family Register (Parivar Register) Excerpt
requiredDocuments.details: Certified copy issued by Gram Panchayat Vikas Adhikari (VDO) in rural areas or Nagar Palika/Nigam tax record in urban areas.
requiredDocuments.issuingAuthority: Gram Panchayat Vikas Adhikari (VDO) / Nagar Palika

requiredDocuments.name: Self-Declaration / Income Affidavit
requiredDocuments.details: Prescribed affidavit on stamp paper or standard e-District self-declaration format declaring annual income.

requiredDocuments.name: Recent Passport Size Photograph
requiredDocuments.details: Color photograph with light/white background taken within recent 3 months.

requiredDocuments.name: Salary Slip / Employer Certificate / ITR
requiredDocuments.details: Mandatory only if any family member is employed in government/private sector or files income tax.

requiredDocuments.name: Land Record (Khatauni) / Agricultural Income Proof
requiredDocuments.details: Excerpts from Uttarakhand Bhulekh portal if family owns agricultural land.

applicationSteps.title: Registration on Apuni Sarkar Portal
applicationSteps.description: Create a citizen profile on eservices.uk.gov.in using mobile number and Aadhaar OTP verification.

applicationSteps.title: Select Service & Fill Family Income Details
applicationSteps.description: Choose Revenue Department -> Income Certificate. Enter district, tehsil, village/ward, and family income breakdown.

applicationSteps.title: Upload Scanned Documents
applicationSteps.description: Upload scanned copies of Parivar register excerpt, income affidavit, identity proof, and recent photograph.

applicationSteps.title: Pay Portal Fee & Obtain Application Receipt
applicationSteps.description: Pay statutory user fee online and note down the application reference tracking number (UK-REV-XXXX).

applicationSteps.title: Patwari Inquiry & Tehsildar Approval
applicationSteps.description: Lekhpal/Patwari conducts field revenue inquiry; Tehsildar issues digitally signed QR-coded certificate.

fees: ₹30 (Direct Online Portal submission) / ₹50 (Common Service Center CSC user fee)
processingTime: 15 working days under Uttarakhand Right to Service (RTS) Act

serviceName: Caste Certificate (SC / ST / OBC - जाति प्रमाण पत्र)
description: Statutory certificate issued by the Revenue Department authenticating Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), or Other Backward Class (OBC) status for constitutional reservations, educational fee concessions, and government recruitment.
eligibility: Applicant must belong to an officially notified SC, ST, or OBC community in Uttarakhand.
Must possess paternal ancestral revenue records proving continuous residence in Uttarakhand prior to the notified state cutoff date.
For OBC category, household annual income must be within the Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) ceiling.

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card / Photo ID of Applicant
requiredDocuments.details: Self-attested identity proof with verified address.

requiredDocuments.name: Father’s Caste Certificate / Ancestral Land Records
requiredDocuments.details: Paternal lineage proof: father's caste certificate, old ancestral Khatauni specifying caste, or ancestral school transfer certificate.

requiredDocuments.name: Uttarakhand Domicile / Permanent Residence Certificate (Mool Niwas)
requiredDocuments.details: Proof of permanent residential connection with Uttarakhand.

requiredDocuments.name: Family Register Excerpt (Parivar Register)
requiredDocuments.details: Gram Panchayat or municipal body family register copy establishing genealogical link to father.
requiredDocuments.issuingAuthority: Gram Panchayat Vikas Adhikari (VDO) / Nagar Palika

requiredDocuments.name: Self-Declaration / Caste & Lineage Affidavit
requiredDocuments.details: Affidavit affirming caste denomination, lineage veracity, and non-creamy layer criteria for OBC.

requiredDocuments.name: Recent Passport Size Photograph
requiredDocuments.details: Recent color photograph of applicant.

applicationSteps.title: Log in to Apuni Sarkar
applicationSteps.description: Access eservices.uk.gov.in using citizen credentials.

applicationSteps.title: Select Category & Ancestral Lineage Details
applicationSteps.description: Choose SC, ST, or OBC category. Fill in sub-caste denomination, father's particulars, and ancestral village.

applicationSteps.title: Upload Paternal Proof & Domicile
applicationSteps.description: Attach scanned father's caste proof or old Khatauni, Parivar register excerpt, residence proof, and photo.

applicationSteps.title: Fee Payment & Reference Generation
applicationSteps.description: Pay statutory portal fee and retain the acknowledgement slip with reference number.

applicationSteps.title: Patwari Verification & Tehsildar/SDM Issuance
applicationSteps.description: Revenue Patwari conducts field inquiry; Tehsildar or Sub-Divisional Magistrate issues digitally signed certificate.

processingTime: 15 working days under Uttarakhand Right to Service (RTS) Act

serviceName: Family Register Copy (परिवार रजिस्टर की नकल / Parivar Register Nakal)
department: Panchayati Raj Department, Government of Uttarakhand
description: Certified excerpt of the official Gram Panchayat Family Register (कुटुंब रजिस्टर / फॉर्म 2) detailing family head, living members, familial relationships, dates of birth, and house numbers. Essential foundational proof of family relationship and local residence for income, caste, and domicile certificates in Uttarakhand.
eligibility: Family must be registered in the Gram Panchayat register (Kutumb Register) of the respective village in Uttarakhand.
Applicant must be a listed family member, head of family, or authorized representative.

requiredDocuments.name: Applicant's Aadhaar Card / Voter ID (Photo ID)
requiredDocuments.details: Self-attested identity proof.

requiredDocuments.name: Written Application Form / Plain Paper Request
requiredDocuments.details: Application addressed to Gram Panchayat Vikas Adhikari (VDO) or online form on Apuni Sarkar.

requiredDocuments.name: House Number / Gram Sabha Ward Details
requiredDocuments.details: Village name, Majra, and house number to help locate the family register volume.

applicationSteps.title: Submission of Request (Offline or Online)
applicationSteps.description: Offline: Submit written request to Gram Vikas Adhikari (VDO / Panchayat Secretary) at the Gram Panchayat office. Online: Log in to Apuni Sarkar (eservices.uk.gov.in) -> Panchayati Raj -> Copy of Family Register.

applicationSteps.title: Register Volume Verification
applicationSteps.description: Gram Vikas Adhikari checks the official physical Kutumb Register (Form 2) or e-Panchayat digital register volume for the specified Gram Sabha and family head.

applicationSteps.title: Issuance of Certified Excerpt
applicationSteps.description: Gram Vikas Adhikari prepares and signs the certified excerpt bearing official seal and register page/serial number.

responsibleAuthority: Gram Vikas Adhikari (VDO) / Panchayat Secretary, Panchayati Raj Department

serviceName: Domicile / Permanent Resident Certificate (स्थायी निवास प्रमाण पत्र / मूल निवास)
description: Statutory certificate proving permanent residential connection with the state of Uttarakhand for state government recruitment, college domicile quotas, and legal entitlements.
eligibility: Uninterrupted continuous residence in Uttarakhand for minimum 15 years, OR ancestral residence prior to the state creation.
Child of parents holding certified permanent resident status in Uttarakhand.
Studied in recognized schools of Uttarakhand for at least 3 years or holding ancestral immovable property.

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card / Voter ID of Applicant
requiredDocuments.details: Self-attested identity proof with Uttarakhand address.

requiredDocuments.name: 15-Year Residence Proof / Ancestral Land Records
requiredDocuments.details: Ancestral land registry, Khatauni, municipal house tax receipts, or continuous utility records.

requiredDocuments.name: School Leaving Certificate / Educational Certificates
requiredDocuments.details: Class 10 or Transfer Certificate from recognized Uttarakhand school/college.

requiredDocuments.name: Family Register Excerpt (Parivar Register)
requiredDocuments.details: Gram Panchayat or municipal body family register copy.
requiredDocuments.issuingAuthority: Gram Panchayat Vikas Adhikari (VDO) / Nagar Palika

requiredDocuments.name: Affidavit of Permanent Residence
requiredDocuments.details: Notarized declaration detailing duration of stay in Uttarakhand.

applicationSteps.title: Select Permanent Resident Certificate Service
applicationSteps.description: Log in to Apuni Sarkar (eservices.uk.gov.in) and navigate to Revenue Department -> Permanent Resident Certificate.

applicationSteps.title: Provide Residential Timeline & Education
applicationSteps.description: Enter total years of stay in Uttarakhand, ancestral village, and school details.

applicationSteps.title: Upload Proofs
applicationSteps.description: Upload educational certificates, Parivar register copy, land/property papers, and affidavit.

applicationSteps.title: Patwari Field Verification & Tehsildar Lifelong Issuance
applicationSteps.description: Revenue Patwari validates the residency period; Tehsildar approves and issues certificate with lifelong validity.

fees: ₹30 (Direct Online Portal submission) / ₹50 (Common Service Center CSC user fee)
processingTime: 15 working days under Uttarakhand Right to Service (RTS) Act

department: Panchayati Raj & Urban Development, Government of Uttarakhand
description: Primary legal identity and age document registering the birth of a child in rural or urban Uttarakhand under the Registration of Births and Deaths Act 1969.
eligibility: Birth took place within the territorial jurisdiction of Uttarakhand (hospital or home birth).
Institutional births reported directly by hospital authorities, or home births reported within statutory timeline.

requiredDocuments.name: Hospital Birth Slip / Discharge Summary (Form 1)
requiredDocuments.details: Medical slip certifying date, time, and sex of baby.

requiredDocuments.name: Parents' Aadhaar Cards
requiredDocuments.details: Identity proof of mother and father.

requiredDocuments.name: Parents' Address Proof in Uttarakhand
requiredDocuments.details: Electricity bill, Voter card, or Parivar Register copy.

requiredDocuments.details: Required only if registering after 21 days from birth date.

applicationSteps.title: Hospital Reporting or Registration Application
applicationSteps.description: Most hospitals submit data directly to CRS/e-District. For home births, apply via Gram Vikas Adhikari (rural) or Nagar Palika (urban) or Apuni Sarkar.

applicationSteps.description: Registrar verifies medical records and parental identities.

applicationSteps.title: QR Code Certificate Download
applicationSteps.description: Registrar issues digitally signed birth certificate with official verification seal.

serviceName: Social Welfare Pension Schemes (Old Age / Widow / Disability - समाज कल्याण पेंशन)
department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand
description: Monthly direct financial assistance (DBT) for eligible senior citizens (60+), destitute widows, and persons with certified benchmark disability (40%+).
eligibility: Old Age Pension: Age 60 years or above, permanent resident of Uttarakhand, family income below BPL/notified limit.
Widow Pension: 18 years or older, death of lawful husband, living below prescribed income ceiling.
Disability Pension: Minimum 40% benchmark disability certified by Chief Medical Officer (CMO) board.
Active savings bank account seeded with Aadhaar for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

requiredDocuments.name: Age Proof (Voter ID / Matriculation / CMO Age Certificate)
requiredDocuments.details: Proof proving age criteria (60+ for Old Age).

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card with Mobile Linkage
requiredDocuments.details: Essential for biometric verification and PFMS DBT mapping.

requiredDocuments.name: Bank Passbook Copy (Account Number & IFSC)
requiredDocuments.details: Core banking passbook first page showing applicant name.

requiredDocuments.name: Income Certificate / BPL Family Proof
requiredDocuments.details: Tehsildar income certificate or BPL card excerpt.

requiredDocuments.name: Husband's Death Certificate (For Widow Pension)
requiredDocuments.details: Required only for destitute widow pension applicants.

requiredDocuments.name: CMO Disability Certificate with UDID (For Divyang Pension)
requiredDocuments.details: Required only for disability pension (minimum 40% disability).

applicationSteps.title: Select Specific Pension Category
applicationSteps.description: Choose Old Age, Widow, or Disability on Apuni Sarkar or Social Welfare portal.

applicationSteps.title: Input Aadhaar & DBT Bank Details
applicationSteps.description: Enter 12-digit Aadhaar and active bank account number and IFSC.

applicationSteps.title: Attach Income & Category Proofs
applicationSteps.description: Upload Tehsildar income certificate, age proof, bank passbook, and medical/death certificates as applicable.

applicationSteps.title: Panchayat Verification & DSWO Sanction
applicationSteps.description: Gram Panchayat Vikas Adhikari validates physical residency; District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO) sanctions monthly allowance.

fees: Completely free application process (Zero government fee)
processingTime: 30 working days under Uttarakhand Right to Service (RTS) Act
responsibleAuthority: District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO), Social Welfare Department
